defs: def sdl: [.assets | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("schemas/")) | .value] | join("\n"); def fields($type): sdl | [capture("type " + $type + "(\\s[^{]*)?\\{(?<b>[^}]*)\\}").b | split("\n")[] | select(test("^\\s*[a-z_]+:")) ]; def typed($type): fields($type) | map(capture("^\\s*(?<n>[a-z_]+): (?<t>[A-Za-z\\[\\]!]+)") | {key: .n, value: .t}) | from_entries; def entries: (.entries | if type == "object" then .entries else . end);

jq.name: the live scenario's seed fits ResearchRequest: request_id is the run id, topic the prompt, graph_id, brief and note the string seed fields
a seeded ResearchRequest runs the researcher under the run id, and its ResearchReceipt carries that id to the scenario's trigger
jq.expr: (.config.event_sources[] | select(.source_collection == "ResearchRequest") | .event_source_id == "research-request" and .correlation_field == "request_id") and (.config.triggers[] | select(.trigger_id == "research-request") | .source.event_source_id == "research-request" and .task_id == "claim-research-task") and ([.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | entries[] | select(.collection == "ResearchReceipt") | .fields[] | select(.name == "request_id") | .fill] == ["correlation"])

jq.name: the collections the live scenario counts are the pack's
the researcher task needs only the fields a string-only seed can set, and says what an unset value means
jq.expr: (.assets["tasks/claim_research_task/prompt.md"] | contains("{{ doc.max_sources }}") and contains("{{ doc.create_graph }}")) and (.assets["agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md"] | contains("A value shown as `none` is unset; `max_sources` unset means 4.") and contains("whatever `create_graph` says"))
